title: Stable laws for heavy-tailed observables on polynomially mixing billiards
summary: We investigate the competition between two distinct mechanisms generating stable laws in deterministic dynamical systems: slow mixing of the system and heavy-tailed observables. For heavy-tailed observables on polynomially mixing billiards with cusps we show these two mechanisms interact and there is a transition, depending on the mixing exponent and the index of the heavy-tailed observable, such that the limit law is determined by either the observable or the dynamics.
